title: Chest Primer
description: Chest Primer is a clientside  lightweight, quality-of-life mod designed for players who build automatic storage systems. If you have ever spent time manually putting a single item into every slot of a chest to "prime" it for sorting, this mod is for you.
body:
# Chest Primer
*Never manually seed a chest again.* Now... **Prime your chests!**

A lightweight Quality of Life mod that instantly prepares standard chests for automatic sorting systems. No more manually splitting stacks to fill empty slots or constantly reorganizing your chests! 

Local client execution makes it safe to enjoy on servers and in your own local world.

Your new go-to organizer is just a button press away. 

## Features
* **One-Click Priming:** Instantly fills all empty chest slots using the items already inside. Advanced algorithms automatically organize and balance your items for effortless use.
* **Row/Column Toggling:** Hover over the button and scroll your mouse wheel to switch between row-based and column-based filling.
* **Adaptive UI:** The button automatically matches the aesthetic of your inventory mod. Currently supports *Inventory Profiles Next* and *Nemo's Inventory Sorting*.

## How It Works
1. Open a vanilla chest.
2. Hover the **P - Primer** button.
3. Scroll through to switch between Row/Column filling.
4. Click the **P - Primer** button.
5. Done! All slots are sorted and filled.
